basic_details.job_title: Sub-Divisional Office Dhule Revenue Servant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 24 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule Division, Dhule, District Dhule, Maharashtra, has invited applications for 24 posts of Revenue Servant (Kotwal) (Mahsul Sevak) - temporary under Advt No. 01/2026. The online application is open from 5 November 2026 to 20 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online by net banking, debit card, credit card, Google Pay or PhonePe; bank processing charges extra. Last date to pay the fee: 20 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Minimum educational qualification: 4th pass. The candidate must live in a village of the saja applied for and must be physically able to perform the duties of the post.
qualification.details: Qualification: Minimum educational qualification of 4th pass; Resident of a village included in the saja applied for; Physically able to perform the duties of the post Age limit: 18 to 40 years (as on 5 November 2026) | Other conditions: | Must be a resident of a village included in the saja applied for; proof is required with the application. Must be physically able to do field work; reservation for persons with disabilities does not apply. Age and domicile certificate showing residence in Maharashtra is required. No horizontal reservation for project-affected persons, ex-servicemen or sportspersons, as there is one post per saja. Heirs of the saja's previous Kotwal get preference when all other things are equal.

exam_pattern.details: Exam for posts in all talukas of Dhule Sub-Division held on the same day at the same time. Admit card to be downloaded from the website from 01-12-2026 to 08-12-2026; entry only with the admit card.

how_to_apply: Apply only online at https://dhule.bhartiportal.org between 05-11-2026 (10.00 AM) and 20-11-2026 (05.45 PM); no other mode is accepted.
Upload educational documents, other certificates, undertakings and the Village Revenue Officer's certificate of residence in a village of the saja.
Upload a latest scanned passport-size photo and signature as instructed on the portal.
Pay the processing fee online by net banking, debit card, credit card, Google Pay or PhonePe and make sure the transaction is successful.
Apply in only one saja, after checking the reservation of that saja.
Detailed instructions for the online application are on https://dhule.bhartiportal.org.
important_instructions: Candidates registered with the employment guidance centre or other offices must still apply online and pay the fee separately. Open-category women must claim women's reservation in the online form. Information filled in the online form cannot be changed. No travel or other expenses are paid for attending the exam or document verification. The number of posts and the reservation may increase or decrease. Admit cards and notices are only on the website; nothing is sent by post.

content_sections.heading: Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 01/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Minimum educational qualification of 4th pass; Resident of a village included in the saja applied for; Physically able to perform the duties of the post Age limit: 18 to 40 years (as on 5 November 2026) Other conditions: Must be a resident of a village included in the saja applied for; proof is required with the application. Must be physically able to do field work; reservation for persons with disabilities does not apply. Age and domicile certificate showing residence in Maharashtra is required. No horizontal reservation for project-affected persons, ex-servicemen or sportspersons, as there is one post per saja. Heirs of the saja's previous Kotwal get preference when all other things are equal.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates against whom any offence is registered or who have been fined or punished by any court. Candidates who do not live in a village of the saja applied for.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is purely temporary. Terms of appointment and service as per Revenue and Forest Department Resolution No. PKA/1051/L-6 dated 07/05/1959. The Kotwal post is unclassified. Caste validity certificate must be submitted within 6 months of the provisional appointment order, otherwise the appointment is cancelled retrospectively.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online by net banking, debit card, credit card, Google Pay or PhonePe; bank processing charges extra. Last date to pay the fee: 20 November 2026.

rows.event: Last date for online fee payment (05.45 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written examination (100 marks, 50 objective questions on general knowledge) Provisional list for original document verification Original document verification Final selection list Written test: objective multiple choice, 50 questions, 100 marks, based on general knowledge. Minimum 40 marks in the written test are required for appointment. Provisional list for original document verification is published at the Tahsil office and on the website. Tie between two candidates other than heirs is resolved by the General Administration Department GR dated 13 June 2018. Eligibility is finalised only after medical examination.

content_sections.heading: Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Exam for posts in all talukas of Dhule Sub-Division held on the same day at the same time. Admit card to be downloaded from the website from 01-12-2026 to 08-12-2026; entry only with the admit card.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Village Revenue Officer's certificate of residence in a village of the saja (upload) Educational documents, other certificates and undertakings (upload) Scanned passport-size photo and signature (upload) Caste certificate and non-creamy layer certificate valid up to 31 March 2027 (backward classes, at scrutiny) Police station certificate and police character certificate (at verification) Physical fitness certificate, Rs. 100 stamp-paper affidavit of no political party link, small family affidavit Form A (at verification)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only online at https://dhule.bhartiportal.org between 05-11-2026 (10.00 AM) and 20-11-2026 (05.45 PM); no other mode is accepted. Upload educational documents, other certificates, undertakings and the Village Revenue Officer's certificate of residence in a village of the saja. Upload a latest scanned passport-size photo and signature as instructed on the portal. Pay the processing fee online by net banking, debit card, credit card, Google Pay or PhonePe and make sure the transaction is successful. Apply in only one saja, after checking the reservation of that saja. Detailed instructions for the online application are on https://dhule.bhartiportal.org.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates registered with the employment guidance centre or other offices must still apply online and pay the fee separately. Open-category women must claim women's reservation in the online form. Information filled in the online form cannot be changed. No travel or other expenses are paid for attending the exam or document verification. The number of posts and the reservation may increase or decrease. Admit cards and notices are only on the website; nothing is sent by post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 November 2026. Applications opened on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 vacancies for Revenue Servant (Kotwal) (Mahsul Sevak) - temporary.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Sub-Divisional Officer, Dhule Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Open Category: Rs. 600. Backward Category: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years (as on 5 November 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium of Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum educational qualification: 4th pass. The candidate must live in a village of the saja applied for and must be physically able to perform the duties of the post.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a resident of a village included in the saja applied for; proof is required with the application. Must be physically able to do field work; reservation for persons with disabilities does not apply. Age and domicile certificate showing residence in Maharashtra is required. No horizontal reservation for project-affected persons, ex-servicemen or sportspersons, as there is one post per saja.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates against whom any offence is registered or who have been fined or punished by any court. Candidates who do not live in a village of the saja applied for.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written examination (100 marks, 50 objective questions on general knowledge). Provisional list for original document verification. Original document verification. Final selection list.
